_about: The meadow biome: the perfected style scene's choices as data (rules-system.md 2). Painters read 'sheets', 'lawn' and 'shadow'; 'palette' is every colour the biome may use, as [family, tone] codes on the house ramps (tone 6 = the family's edge tone) or 'ink', and a finished picture is restricted to it; 'materials', 'plants' and 'edges' name the kit pieces the biome draws with, so a lane can see what is shared and what a new biome must supply.

edges._about: the meadow's edge set, all in the c-tiles painters (terrain/tiles.py, terrain/scene.py)
edges.turf lip: tiles.face fringe: one darker row on a 1 px wobble (PROF), a streak zone under it at 2x; r7: an occasional tuft hangs over it (style.lip.tuft_every), no comb of blades; scene.soften_lip rounds right-angle steps in the plan's soften_lips boxes
edges.face foot: toe stones straddling every straight foot run every 8 to 14 world px; contact shade 3 rows
edges.side band: tiles.top cut bands: a lit west band following the lumps; r7: the dark east band's outer edge a soft wave (no lump teeth)
edges.floor rim: r7: the ledge floor's rim and its lit row wander 0 to 3 art px in one-px steps (runs of 2 to 6 world px), the lit row broken now and then
edges.water's edge: earth bank lit south and east; waterline wobble where a face stands in the pool; r7: the pool's dark bands traced from its smoothed shoreline (scene.pool_bands, style.water), bank stones in overlapping runs half under the water (plan water.bank_runs), the brook's bank line in runs, its light lane on the outside of bends, shallows inside them, stones standing in it (plan water.brook_stones)
edges.path edge: tiles.over('trail'): grass over the dirt 1 to 3 world px, tufts and bites, a damp row, crumbs

lawn._about: the 2x lawn: about half the field near flat, the mottle and tuft clumps gather in the other half (MEASURE.md bands)

measure._about: MEASURE.md (in this folder): the edge share over the lawn mask at 2x (Claude A, 21 Oct: Matt asked for more grass, the 1.5x amount, so the band moved from 0.17-0.21 to 0.20-0.24); lone px under the house ceiling

sheets._about: seeds of the canvas-sized fields and the face sheet the tiles are cut from

shadow._about: every cast shadow: the silhouette thrown east and down by (kx, ky) of its height in world units, two ramp tones down with a one-tone rim, a dappled rim under crowns, a contact line under every foot

style._about: r7: the painters' style numbers as data (they read these, with the same values as defaults in code). stone: stone_paint's ramp thresholds on the light, the share of face boulders with moss, world px² of stone per texture mark, the radius (world px) above which a boulder may split into overlapping lumps (r8: 2 lumps, 3 when 6 world px larger still, with curved gaps 1.4 to 3 px wide; about a third of the larger boulders stay whole); the joint between two whole boulders (art px, on the boulder behind, a tone-1 shade beyond, a third of the pairs overlapping with shade only); the share of shade and body under a soft sibling-hue mottle. foliage: readable clumps per crown, the clump field's share of the tone field, the lit side's leaf-jagged rim one tone down, lit leaves on the cool sibling. lawn: the dressing tufts' size range, the calm untufted band round crowns, bushes and trunk bases (world px). lip: world px between the tufts hanging over a lip. water: the pool's shoreline smoothing, its dark bands [family, tone, inset in world px] under rock banks, the brook's half-width range and the run length of its bank line.
